description: This file defines the class EditViewMerge, which handles merging and managing meta data related to view definitions in the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for loading, merging, and saving metadata for form views in the SuiteCRM module framework, including panel and field management.

classes.name: EditViewMerge
classes.description: A class that manages merging of view metadata for SuiteCRM modules, including panel and field data, with methods for loading, merging, and saving view definitions.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal arrays for reuse.

methods.name: setBestMatch
methods.description: Enables or disables the best match algorithm for panel field placement.

methods.name: setDefaultPanel
methods.description: Sets the default panel name for view layouts.

methods.name: setLogFilePointer
methods.description: Sets an open file pointer for logging.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Opens a file and sets it as the log destination.

methods.name: areMatchingValues
methods.description: Compares two values for equality, considering arrays.

methods.name: arrayMerge
methods.description: Recursively merges two arrays, with values from the second array overriding.

methods.name: mergeField
methods.description: Merges individual field meta data considering original, new, and custom data and determines the resulting merged metadata.

methods.name: mergeFields
methods.description: Merges all fields considering original, new, and custom data into $mergedFields.

methods.name: buildPanels
methods.description: Constructs the panels layout for the merged view based on merged fields and placement logic.

methods.name: mergeTemplateMeta
methods.description: Merges templateMeta section with precedence to custom data.

methods.name: setPanels
methods.description: Assigns the constructed panels layout into the new data structure.

methods.name: mergeMetaData
methods.description: Coordinates the merging of metadata including fields, panels, and templateMeta.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Extracts fields from panel layouts, assigning metadata and location info.

methods.name: getPanelIds
methods.description: Retrieves panel IDs from panel layouts.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads original, new, and custom view meta data from files into internal variables.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current new data to a specified file.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current merged view metadata.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Main method to orchestrate merging metadata from original, new, and custom files, optionally saving the result.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the specified log file or global log object.
